name: compliance-adapters
description: Integration adapters connecting Stellar compliance primitives to SEP-10 auth, sanctions oracles, and Horizon event streams.

scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:start && npm run test:e2e:test-only ; npm run test:e2e:stop
scripts.test:e2e:ci: npm run test:e2e:start && npm run test:e2e:test-only ; docker-compose -f e2e-tests/docker-compose.yml down -v || true
scripts.test:integration:horizon-listener: npm run test:e2e:start && npm run test:integration:horizon-listener --workspace=e2e-tests ; npm run test:e2e:stop
scripts.test:integration:horizon-listener:ci: npm run test:e2e:start && npm run test:integration:horizon-listener --workspace=e2e-tests ; docker-compose -f e2e-tests/docker-compose.yml down -v || true
scripts.lint: eslint sep10-auth/src sanctions-oracle/src horizon-listener/src tracing-types/src examples/full-stack-demo/server.js --ext .ts,.js
